2026-09-16, normalized 32x32-cell import-ready props atlas (256x608 RGBA) built from mq0_props_forest_v2_source.png: 27 sprites (campfire lit/unlit 2x2, torch lit/unlit 1x2 plus a 1x1 'torch_lit_01_compact' fallback for tight spots, 4 logs 2x1/1x2, 2 signposts 1x2, 2 stumps 2x2, 7 rocks 1x1-3x2, 3 flowers 1x1, 4 weeds 1x1), individually cropped, largest-connected-component denoised, and resized with premultiplied alpha. 2026-09-16, normalized 32x32-cell modular horizontal-bridge atlas (256x128 RGBA) built from mq0_bridge_forest_v2_source.png: bridge_h_left/right (1x2, end caps with a diagonal support strut) + bridge_h_center_01/02 (1x2, a plank-width slice of a railing panel, verified to tile seamlessly against itself and the other variant in any order) + bridge_post_01/02 (1x2, base cell blocking). Any bridge length >= 2 tiles is reachable in 1-tile steps via center repeats; verified with 3/5/7-tile test bridges. Deck tiles carry no collision (river Collision is untouched elsewhere); applied to tiled/maps/mq0_map01_starting_place_day.tmj replacing the 7-tile DEV_PLACEHOLDER bridge_wood at its existing position/width. See docs/PHASE_NO01_OUTDOOR_TILESET_SPEC.md.

2026-09-15, first pass at a real outdoor tileset (1448x1086 RGB). Measured native cell pitch is ~71-72px, not 32px or a clean multiple of it; no alpha channel; cliff/long-bridge art is drawn as one continuous mural rather than independent repeatable tiles. Good style/color/tree-size direction, but not sliceable into a production .tsj as-is. See docs/PHASE_NO01_OUTDOOR_TILESET_SPEC.md for the full evaluation and the regeneration checklist. Do not treat as ready_to_import until re-exported at a clean 32px multiple with transparency and modular cliff/bridge pieces.
